title: Sextante
description: SE80-style workbench inside VS Code on top of SAP ABAP Development Tools: systems, object search, object tree, one-click actions, dictionary in context and an AI agent over MCP.

title: Annotate Markdown Preview
description: Highlight, comment, color-code, and attach links in the official VS Code Markdown preview. Annotations live in a sidecar file next to your document.

title: Agent Sessions Dashboard
description: See every AI coding agent session you have running, as a Kanban board or a list, and spot the one that's waiting on you.

title: Tugline Agent: coding agent for any model
description: A coding agent that runs on the model you choose (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, your company server or any OpenAI-compatible API). Sandboxed commands, reviewable edits, and runs verified by your own tests.

title: ADITO View Preview
description: Visualize ADITO view YAML files as an interactive layout tree.

title: Worktree View
description: A lightweight git worktree board in Source Control: see what every AI agent worktree (Claude, Codex, Cursor, .agent…) changed and diff it natively. 轻量 worktree 看板，原生 diff 对比各个 AI worktree 的改动。

title: JetGit
description: JetBrains-like Git experience for VS Code: right-click Git menu, commit dialog and branch popup panel. 类 JetBrains 的 Git 右键菜单、提交窗口与分支面板。

title: IntelliJ Java/Kotlin Navigation
description: IntelliJ-style interface / implementation / override navigation ('1 implementation', '↑ Interface' hints) in Java and Kotlin. Works on top of any language server (e.g. JetBrains' 'Java and Kotlin by IntelliJ IDEA').
